hook.en: A clipper cuts a wave; a clamper moves it. With just a capacitor and a diode, a sine wave centred on zero can be lifted so that it sits entirely above zero.
hook.kn: ಕ್ಲಿಪ್ಪರ್ ತರಂಗವನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಕ್ಲ್ಯಾಂಪರ್ ಅದನ್ನು ಸರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಒಂದು ಧಾರಕ ಮತ್ತು ಡಯೋಡ್‌ನಿಂದ ಶೂನ್ಯದ ಸುತ್ತಲಿನ ಸೈನ್ ತರಂಗವನ್ನು ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಶೂನ್ಯದ ಮೇಲಕ್ಕೆ ಎತ್ತಬಹುದು.

objectives.en: Explain the working of a positive and a negative clamper
Find the output levels with an ideal and a silicon diode
State the RC condition and uses

narration.en: A clipper cuts a wave; a clamper moves it. With just a capacitor and a diode, a sine wave centred on zero can be lifted so that it sits entirely above zero.
narration.kn: ಕ್ಲಿಪ್ಪರ್ ತರಂಗವನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಕ್ಲ್ಯಾಂಪರ್ ಅದನ್ನು ಸರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಒಂದು ಧಾರಕ ಮತ್ತು ಡಯೋಡ್‌ನಿಂದ ಶೂನ್ಯದ ಸುತ್ತಲಿನ ಸೈನ್ ತರಂಗವನ್ನು ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಶೂನ್ಯದ ಮೇಲಕ್ಕೆ ಎತ್ತಬಹುದು.

body.en: A clamper adds a DC level to an AC signal without changing its shape. It has a capacitor in series and a diode across the output (with a resistor or load across it). In a positive clamper, during the negative peak the diode conducts and C charges to $V_m$. Then the diode stays off and C acts as a battery of $V_m$ in series with the input, so $v_o = v_i + V_m$: the output swings from 0 to $+2V_m$. Reversing the diode gives a negative clamper with output from 0 to $-2V_m$. Clampers are also called DC restorers.

narration.en: In a positive clamper the capacitor charges to Vm through the diode, then adds Vm to the input, so the output runs from zero to two Vm.
narration.kn: ಧನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ಲ್ಯಾಂಪರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಧಾರಕ ಡಯೋಡ್ ಮೂಲಕ Vm ಗೆ ಆವೇಶಗೊಂಡು ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ಗೆ Vm ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ 0 ಯಿಂದ 2Vm ವರೆಗೆ.

narration.en: On the board: the positive clamper.

say.en: A capacitor in series and a diode across the output. On the negative peak the diode conducts and charges C to Vm.

text.en: Neg. half: D on, C → Vm

say.en: Now C acts like a battery of Vm in series with the input. The whole wave is lifted: it swings from 0 to 2Vm without changing shape.
Reverse the diode for a negative clamper. A real silicon diode leaves 0.7 V, and RC must be large compared with the period.

text.en: Si diode: C charges to Vm − 0.7
RC much more than T so C holds its charge

body.en: With a silicon diode, C charges only to $V_m - 0.7$ V, so a positive clamper gives an output from −0.7 V to $2V_m - 0.7$ V. The time constant $R_LC$ must be much larger (at least about 5 to 10 times) than the period of the input so that C hardly discharges between peaks. A battery in series with the diode (biased clamper) clamps the wave at any chosen level. Uses: restoring the DC level of video signals in TV receivers, and voltage multipliers.

points.en: Si diode: output from −0.7 V to 2Vm − 0.7 V
Biased clamper: clamp at any level
Uses: TV DC restorer, voltage multipliers

narration.en: A real silicon diode leaves 0.7 volt, and the RC time constant must be much longer than the period of the input.
narration.kn: ಸಿಲಿಕಾನ್ ಡಯೋಡ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ 0.7 V ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ; RC ಕಾಲ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಆವರ್ತ ಕಾಲಕ್ಕಿಂತ ತುಂಬಾ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿರಬೇಕು.

problem.en: A clamper works at 1 kHz with RL = 100 kΩ. Choose C so that RLC is at least 10 times the period.

steps.en: Choosing C = 1 µF gives RLC = 100 ms, safely large.

answer.en: C ≥ 0.1 µF (1 µF is a safe choice)

narration.en: Recap. Clampers add DC without changing shape. Positive clamper: 0 to +2Vm; negative: 0 to −2Vm. Si diode shifts the clamp level by 0.7 V. RC must be much larger than the input period.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಕ್ಲ್ಯಾಂಪರ್‌ಗಳು ಆಕಾರ ಬದಲಿಸದೆ DC ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಧನಾತ್ಮಕ ಕ್ಲ್ಯಾಂಪರ್: 0 ಇಂದ +2Vm; ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕ: 0 ಇಂದ −2Vm. ಸಿಲಿಕಾನ್ ಡಯೋಡ್ ಕ್ಲ್ಯಾಂಪ್ ಮಟ್ಟವನ್ನು 0.7 V ಸರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. RC ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಆವರ್ತ ಕಾಲಕ್ಕಿಂತ ತುಂಬಾ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿರಬೇಕು.
